verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

verses.text: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.

segments.text: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.

verses.text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah

segments.text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah

verses.text: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

segments.text: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.

verses.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

segments.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah

verses.text: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

segments.text: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.

verses.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

segments.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

verses.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah

segments.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah

verses.text: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

segments.text: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.

verses.text: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.

segments.text: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.

verses.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.

segments.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.

verses.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

segments.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

verses.text: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

segments.text: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
